reference.architecture: official CUDA histogram backend; not the CPU histogram builder

validation_scope.host_reference: source-derived contracts and CUDA-shared host-executable definitions
validation_scope.warning: Source identity and host tests do not establish device parity or device support.

supported_target.features: in-memory dense numeric input with explicit missing values
supported_target.sampling_first_checkpoint: all row and column fractions equal one; fixed cuts
supported_target.sampling_qlib_checkpoint: uniform row sampling and colsample_bytree from frozen effective config

initial_support.policy: Explicit NPU requests fail on unsupported capability; never silently dispatch dense kernels to CPU.

numerics.scale_construction: positive/negative channel sums reduced on device; max bound and total rows feed CreateRoundingFactor<double>; floating scale = rounding / 2^62; fixed scale = reciprocal
numerics.conversion: truncate toward zero; preserve positive source Hessian as integer one if it truncates to zero
numerics.statistics: integer root, histogram, exclusive scan, missing residual and sibling subtraction; dequantize for gain and weights
numerics.floating_evaluator: CUDA scalar SplitEvaluator uses float leaf weights and gain values with dequantized statistics; preserve calculation order and test boundary sensitivity
exact_checks: fixed-point values with supplied identical scales

component_float_tolerance.scope: fixed host contract fixtures; provisional device acceptance requires boundary-specific review

numerics.end_to_end_tolerance: must be fixed before formal device acceptance using frozen data; not inferred from source-only tests
numerics.determinism: fixed cuts, masks and feature order isolate arithmetic; identical seed alone does not imply CPU/CUDA/NPU sampling sequence equality
numerics.integer_capability_gate: Validate int64 accumulation, conversions and scaling on Ascend. Use an independently verified Ascend C implementation if ACLNN cannot satisfy the contract; floating ScatterAdd is not an equivalent substitute.

components.host: parameter, label and shape validation; objective setup and initial intercept orchestration
components.synchronization: gradient generation ordered before quantizer bounds and training; validation summaries only

components.host: initial cut preparation allowed and reported; matrix metadata
components.device: persistent binned representation; layout adapted to NPU, not a CUDA compression clone
components.synchronization: one-time upload; dataset identity/cut hashes preserved
components.rule: numeric bin uses upper_bound and clamps end to final bin; missing contributes no ordinary feature bin

components.host: construct scales from small reduced channel bounds, as CUDA does
components.device: positive/negative bounds reduction, gradient conversion, integer root reduction
components.synchronization: small reduced bounds to host and scales to device, not full gradient downloads

components.host: column set orchestration permitted; all synchronization declared
components.device: apply row mask and zero sampled-out pairs before histograms
components.synchronization: small feature sets and seeds; no repeated full-row transfers
components.rule: test fixed masks first; prediction updates still cover sampled-out training rows; gradient-based sampling deferred

components.device: int64 collision accumulation; later parent-minus-child histogram subtraction

components.host: consume best candidate only; no full candidate scoring on CPU
components.device: exclusive scan, missing=parent-known, both missing directions, regularized scoring and deterministic candidate reduction
components.synchronization: copy compact best-candidate records before host RegTree expansion
rules: DeviceSplitCandidate updates only on strictly greater gain
first exclusive-scan candidate is negative infinity; later threshold is preceding cut
subtract parent gain once after reducing child gain
invalid child Hessian yields negative infinity
feature reduction keeps left operand on equality; never assume minimum feature id independently of feature order
components.unverified_device_detail: CUB lane/segment reduction tie ordering must be checked with CUDA fixtures; a generic NPU ArgMax test alone is insufficient

components.host: node segment metadata and child ranges
components.device: predicate, prefix scan, row scatter and final leaf positions
components.synchronization: child counts to host; full row indices stay resident
components.rule: reconstructed numeric cut <= split threshold for training; missing follows selected default child; test membership separately from physical row order

components.host: reuse Driver, node expansion, stopping decisions, leaf weights times learning rate and model mutation
components.device: independent compute components driven by updater
components.synchronization: explicit candidate/count synchronization before dependent host decisions
components.rule: gain <= kRtEps rejected; gain < gamma rejected (equality allowed above epsilon); depth/leaf limits enforced by Driver

components.host: model serialization, predictor selection and cache version orchestration
components.device: gather leaf contributions for cached training; actual tree traversal for new data
components.synchronization: small model uploads when tree changes; copy final outputs when requested
components.rule: raw numeric feature < split threshold; missing uses default child; cached and uncached predictions must agree including sampled-out rows

components.host: device and capability validation, model lifecycle, optional reported host metrics/early stopping
components.device: independent buffer ownership and correctly dispatched numerical operations
components.synchronization: explicit read/write ownership and stream ordering; no CUDA/SYCL buffer masquerading
components.rule: audit all non-CUDA means CPU branches, tensor device spans, empty-cache prediction shortcuts, registration and CPU-only build isolation

fixed_fixture.name: quantized_histogram_missing_and_empty_bin
fixed_fixture.int64_serialization: decimal strings avoid JSON consumer loss above 2^53

acceptance_gates: host CUDA-source contracts and pinned-source identity
native NPU primitives including quantized int64 numerical path
device component parity against fixed cuts/scales/masks
CPU-controlled NPU single tree then multiple boosting rounds
fresh prediction, cache parity, save/load, explicit CPU/NPU selection
frozen Alpha158 config including nontrivial sampling and early stopping
reproducible CUDA runtime outputs where compatible NVIDIA environment is available; otherwise explicitly pending
real component execution evidence and coordinated end-to-end performance measurement
